title: The Machines a Renew Bulk IT Refresh Wave's Transit Cover Will Bear
content:
How many machines the programme's transit cover will bear follows the value of each machine against that cover, how the value of the whole schedule stands against it, and how long the quote has run, counted in calendar days from the day the quote was given to the day the machines of the wave are settled. The cover is the most the Renew programme will cover for one device lost or damaged on the way in; the value of the whole schedule is the value of each machine taken over the machines the Renew Bulk IT Refresh Agreement covers; and the quote's age is measured against the days that programme allows a quote to be accepted for.

1. Where the value of each machine is at or above the programme's transit cover and the quote has run no longer than the programme's quote validity days, the cover bears one machine.
2. Where the value of each machine is at or above the programme's transit cover and the quote has run longer than the programme's quote validity days, the cover bears no machine until a fresh quote is written.
3. Where the value of each machine is below the programme's transit cover and the value of the whole schedule is above that cover, the cover bears the cover divided by the value of each machine, rounded down to a whole machine.
4. Where the value of each machine is below the programme's transit cover and the value of the whole schedule is at or below that cover, the cover bears the machines the schedule covers.

**Both sides of the boundaries.** A value of each machine standing at exactly the transit cover is at that cover, so the first or second branch governs and not the third or fourth. A quote that has run exactly the programme's quote validity days on the day the machines of the wave are settled has not run longer than them, so the first branch governs. A value of the whole schedule standing at exactly the cover is at that cover and not above it, so the fourth branch governs.

**Worked cases on hypothetical inputs.** Take a transit cover of 1800.00 USD and a programme allowing a quote to be accepted for 45 days.

| Machines the schedule covers | Amount quoted | Value of each machine | Value of the whole schedule | Days the quote has run | Machines the cover bears |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 8 | 16000.00 USD | 2000.00 USD | 16000.00 USD | 30 | 1 |
| 8 | 16000.00 USD | 2000.00 USD | 16000.00 USD | 52 | none until a fresh quote is written |
| 25 | 17500.00 USD | 700.00 USD | 17500.00 USD | 30 | 2 |
| 3 | 1500.00 USD | 500.00 USD | 1500.00 USD | 30 | 3 |

In the third row the cover of 1800.00 USD divided by the value of each machine of 700.00 USD is 2.57, which rounded down to a whole machine is 2. The 1800.00 USD is an illustrative cover figure; the cover that governs is the transit cover the Renew programme carries.
